subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw handle Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-like keys when a user selects general `volcengine` models such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: The source shows a real split between general and coding endpoints while sharing one configured key, but only a maintainer or credentialed tester can confirm the vendor entitlement contract and choose routing versus diagnostics.

options.title: Validate the Lite contract first
options.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys on Coding Plan
options.body: If Lite keys are only valid for `volcengine-plan`, keep the provider split and add earlier diagnostics for users selecting general models with Lite credentials.

options.title: Support the shared key on both endpoints
options.body: If the key should work on the general endpoint too, treat the runtime 401 as an auth/header bug and fix that path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate the Lite contract first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider auth aliases, bundled plugin ownership, setup/runtime compatibility, and user-facing diagnostics where this history is strongest.
